supporting_observations.claim: From 13:31 through 13:45 UTC, FILE-LV-01 repeatedly attempted network logons as svc-reporting, with failures approximately a minute apart. The 4625 records report substatus 0xc000006a, and domain-controller records report the same credential failure or Kerberos pre-authentication failure status 0x18.

The failure cadence and source host are consistent with the supplied inventory context: svc-reporting runs every minute and re-authenticates on FILE-LV-01, and its password rotation was scheduled for 13:30 UTC. This is a plausible benign explanation for the repeated failures, but the records do not confirm the rotation or job update occurred.

At 13:59 UTC, WS-RIYER-01 recorded an explicit-credentials event under SYSTEM targeting svc-reporting on DC-LV-01, with taskhostw.exe listed as the process. The supplied inventory does not describe svc-reporting use from this analyst workstation, making this an unexplained and potentially suspicious event; the record alone does not establish that authentication succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records cover 13:31:01 through 13:59:06 UTC, not the full requested 13:20–14:20 window; lack of later records does not establish that no later activity occurred.
The supplied records contain no process creation, task-scheduler, endpoint detection, or network connection telemetry to explain the taskhostw.exe event on WS-RIYER-01.
The supplied records do not show the password rotation, the ReportSync configuration update, or a successful authentication that would establish their outcome.

Whether any malicious process or user accessed or used svc-reporting credentials.
Whether relevant authentication or endpoint activity occurred during the parts of the requested window for which no records were supplied.
additional_evidence_needed: Review CHG-2291 execution details, including the actual rotation time, operator, and confirmation of the ReportSync job update.
Collect process creation, task-scheduler, and endpoint detection telemetry from WS-RIYER-01 around 13:59 UTC to identify the parent process, task, and initiating context for taskhostw.exe.
Obtain DC-LV-01 and WS-RIYER-01 authentication records around 13:59 UTC, including any corresponding successful logon or subsequent account use.
Collect authentication records for the complete 13:20–14:20 UTC window and ReportSync service/job logs from FILE-LV-01.
